Tomislav Mesarić
Ulica Lipa 12, 10000 Zagreb, Croatia | +385 1 555 0142 | tomislav.mesaric@example.com

PROFESSIONAL PROFILE
Butcher and meat counter professional with experience in retail butchery since 2015. Skilled in breaking down beef, pork and lamb, boning and trimming, portioning meat to order, and advising customers on cuts and cooking. HACCP-trained, with experience recording temperature and hygiene checks, rotating cold-room stock using FIFO, and maintaining clean, safe counters and equipment.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Butcher | Mesnica Kod Ante (family butcher shop), Zagreb | 2019–Present
- Break down 2–3 beef forequarters and 10–12 pork sides each week; bone, trim and portion meat for the counter.
- Prepare four kinds of fresh sausage to the shop’s recipes; produce around 40 kg weekly in the busy season.
- Developed the shop’s lamb merguez recipe and adjusted the ćevapi mix to 70% beef and 30% lamb following customer feedback. The ćevapi won second place at the Zagreb County craft meat fair in 2023.
- Record cold-room (0–4 °C) and display-counter temperature checks twice daily; rotate cold-room stock each morning using FIFO, placing the oldest stock at the front.
- Serve around 120 customers on a Saturday, advising on cuts and cooking times.
- Trained two apprentices in knife handling and cleaning routines.
- Prepared whole lambs and suckling pigs for spit-roasting at weddings and family events, including ordering, butchering, seasoning and delivery. Largest order: four lambs and two pigs for a 180-guest wedding in 2024.
- Kept weight-loss and temperature records during a six-week dry-ageing trial of beef ribs; the shop now sells dry-aged rib by pre-order, around 15 kg per month.

Counter Assistant | Tržnica Dolac meat hall stall, Zagreb | 2015–2019
- Served customers, weighed and priced orders, operated the till and completed cash-up.
- Cleaned and sanitised slicers, mincers and the counter at closing.
- Wrote a closing and cleaning checklist covering the slicer, mincer, counter and floor drain; it remains in use at the stall.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATES
Vocational Certificate: Butcher (3-year programme) | Food Trades School Zagreb | 2015
HACCP Basic Food Hygiene Certificate | 2021; renewed 2024
Preparing for the Master Butcher exam (majstorski ispit), planned for spring 2027

SKILLS
Carcass breakdown (beef, pork and lamb) · Boning and trimming · Portioning meat to order · Fresh sausage making · Knife sharpening · Mincer and bandsaw operation · FIFO stock rotation · Cold-chain temperature and hygiene checks · Customer advice on cuts and cooking · Counter cleaning and sanitation · Cash handling

LANGUAGES
Croatian (native) · English (good) · German (basic)

critique.content_quality_feedback: This is a strong, well-structured CV with clear progression from Counter Assistant to Butcher and highly relevant evidence for the FreshCart role. The quantified production volumes, customer volume, temperature checks, FIFO rotation, apprentice training, sausage production and catering work make the experience credible and impactful. The profile is concise and professionally written. Education, HACCP certification, practical skills and languages are easy to locate. The document also accurately distinguishes the planned Master Butcher exam from a completed qualification. A minor content limitation is that it does not explicitly address supermarket self-service packaging or shift availability, although the candidate information confirms no such supermarket experience and includes a Wednesday scheduling constraint.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: The CV uses standard section headings, conventional reverse-chronological employment history, simple text formatting and searchable keywords such as butcher, meat counter, HACCP, FIFO, temperature checks, portioning, boning, trimming, customer advice and sanitation. It should parse reliably in most ATS systems, and its strong keyword-to-evidence match gives it a high AI screening probability for this vacancy. To improve exact keyword matching slightly, the document could use the job's wording "service counter" and "self-service shelves" only where truthful; the candidate's background supports service-counter work but not self-service packaging. The use of special characters such as °C, en dashes and middle-dot separators is unlikely to cause a material issue, but plain hyphens and standard bullets would provide maximum compatibility across older systems.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: The CV is an excellent match for the two must-have requirements: it shows both completed butcher training and substantially more than two years of meat-counter experience, as well as HACCP knowledge. It aligns particularly well with FreshCart's priorities around fresh food, knowledgeable customer advice, reliability, hygiene, stock rotation and pride in good work. The documented Saturday customer volume and temperature/FIFO routines are highly relevant to a busy supermarket counter. The candidate's Zagreb location also fits the Zagreb-Jarun role, and the CV does not introduce any unsupported work-arrangement claim. The candidate has no forklift licence, which is a stated nice-to-have gap rather than a document defect. The CV also does not show supermarket self-service packaging, tray-sealer or labelling-scale experience; the candidate's notes indicate these are genuine experience gaps, so they should not be presented as existing skills. Shift availability is not stated in the CV, and the candidate has a Wednesday afternoon childcare constraint, so no unrestricted-shift claim should be added.
critique.improvement_instructions:
MINOR ENHANCEMENT: In the Professional Profile, consider changing "experience in retail butchery since 2015" to "9 years' experience in retail butchery and meat-counter service". This makes the duration explicit and mirrors the job's "meat counter" terminology without changing the substance.

MINOR ENHANCEMENT: In the Professional Experience section under Mesnica Kod Ante, change "portion meat for the counter" to "cut, portion and prepare fresh meat for the service counter". This uses the employer's wording while remaining fully supported by the documented work.

MINOR ENHANCEMENT: In the Skills section, change "Cold-chain temperature and hygiene checks" to "HACCP temperature and hygiene checks" only if the candidate is comfortable using HACCP as the framework for these documented checks. Keep the existing HACCP certificate in Education & Certificates; do not describe the candidate as a HACCP team leader or advanced HACCP specialist.

MINOR ENHANCEMENT: In the Professional Experience section under Mesnica Kod Ante, retain or add the existing FIFO evidence as a separate bullet if space permits: "Rotate cold-room stock every morning using FIFO, placing the oldest stock at the front." This is a direct match for the vacancy and is supported by the candidate's notes.

Do not add forklift operation, self-service packaging, tray-sealer use, labelling-scale use, unrestricted shift availability or a completed Master Butcher qualification, because the candidate information does not support those claims.
critique.critical_issues:
Claims the sources (the candidate's own material; for the employer, the job ad and company research) do not support:
- "recording temperature and hygiene checks"
- "Cold-chain temperature and hygiene checks"

critique.content_quality_feedback: This is a strong, well-structured CV with clear progression from Counter Assistant to Butcher, relevant vocational training, HACCP certification, and highly credible quantified achievements. The profile is targeted to a butcher/meat-counter role, and the experience section demonstrates carcass breakdown, sausage production, customer advice, temperature control, FIFO rotation, sanitation, and apprentice training. The wedding catering, sausage-development, competition, and dry-ageing details add useful evidence of practical skill and initiative. The main content defect is the duplicated FIFO bullet, which makes the experience section look insufficiently edited. The planned Master Butcher exam is correctly presented as preparation rather than a completed qualification.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: ATS compatibility is high. The document uses standard section headings, conventional reverse-chronological experience, readable bullet points, and no tables, graphics, columns, or unusual formatting that would hinder parsing. It contains strong role keywords including butcher, meat counter, carcass breakdown, boning, trimming, portioning, sausage making, FIFO, temperature checks, HACCP, customer advice, sanitation, mincer, and bandsaw. AI screening probability is high because the CV provides direct evidence and measurable scale rather than relying only on generic claims. Keyword coverage could be slightly improved by using the ad's exact phrase "HACCP knowledge" and by explicitly mentioning wrapping/packaging fresh meat if desired and supported by the candidate's paper-wrapping experience. The document does not claim unsupported supermarket experience, tray-sealer use, self-service labelling, or forklift operation.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: Alignment is very strong for the stated must-have requirements and the core counter duties. The candidate has completed butcher training, nine years of relevant butchery and meat-counter experience, HACCP certification, customer-facing experience, FIFO stock rotation, and twice-daily temperature recording. The profile also fits FreshCart's stated culture of knowledgeable customer advice, reliability, hygiene, and pride in practical work. Zagreb location and on-site suitability are consistent with the role. The candidate does not have a forklift licence, which is a genuine nice-to-have gap rather than a CV defect. The candidate also has not worked in a supermarket and has not used tray sealers or labelling scales for self-service packs; these are experience gaps relevant to the broader duties, but they should not be misrepresented or presented as completed skills. The CV does not address shift availability, which is acceptable because the candidate has a Wednesday scheduling constraint and should not claim unrestricted availability.

Keep the earlier bullet that also includes the temperature-recording responsibility.

MINOR ATS ENHANCEMENT — In the Professional Profile, change "HACCP-trained, with experience rotating cold-room stock using FIFO" to "HACCP knowledge and training, with experience rotating cold-room stock using FIFO." This uses the job advertisement's exact wording while remaining supported by the HACCP certificate and documented work.

Do not mention tray sealers, labelling scales, or self-service packaging because the candidate has not used them.
